title: lepidaploa subsquarrosa
intro: Lepidaploa subsquarrosa, commonly known as Brazilian fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Lepidaploa subsquarrosa include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory disorders. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, anti-edema, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents.
